Our system is the next target.|The technician and Leia Organa|}} A [[human]] served as a '''technician''' at the [[Resistance base]] on [[D'Qar]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. As the [[Resistance]] was planning their [[Battle of Starkiller Base|attack on Starkiller Base]], the [[technician]] handed [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] a message, stating that the [[First Order]] was charging [[Starkiller Base]] and their [[Ileenium system|system]] was the next target. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The technician was portrayed by an unnamed extra in the [[2015]] movie {{Film|VII}}, while the character's single line was performed by [[Meredith Salenger]]{{SW|url=news/from-blast-that-x-wing-to-traitor-the-voices-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=From "Blast That X-wing!" to "Traitor!": The Voices of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''|date=2016-01-25}} (in an uncredited role), best known for voicing [[Barriss Offee]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news11102009/index.html|text=In the Hands of The Padawans…|date=2009-11-10}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|VII}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]] {{Ab|Star Wars: The Force Awakens (audiobook)}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/from-blast-that-x-wing-to-traitor-the-voices-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=From "Blast That X-wing!" to "Traitor!": The Voices of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Resistance members]] [[Category:Technicians]]
